english.title: Summoned as an inquest juror permit the making of a false representation with intent to evade service
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) having been summoned to act as a juror at an inquest permitted another, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), on your behalf to make a false representation, namely **(..SPECIFY THE FALSIFICATION..), on your behalf with intent that you should evade that jury service
english.legislation: Contrary to paragraph 3(1)(b) and (2) of Schedule 6 to the Coroners and Justice Act 2009.
